scope: Re-audit of three posted contributions and the fourth bmv candidate before posting its PR.

method.enumeration: REST /repos/pypose/pypose/pulls?state=all&per_page=100, all four pages. Independently reconciled original REST is:pr search history: 309 original PRs exactly, plus this campaign's #478/#480/#482. No issue-only wrapper.
method.files: Every prior PR's /files pages retrieved to completion or the documented 3000-file GitHub limit. Relevant current and renamed paths were inspected at function level. The two capped PRs are explicitly handled below.

api_cap_exceptions.result: Complete recursive head tree was not truncated; among the four target paths only convert.py exists. Retrieved its exact head content: both conversions still compute pow(det(...), 1/3). The three other target files are absent.

method.limitations: No equivalent fix found in retrieved public history; not a claim about deleted/private branches or future submissions. GitHub /files cap does not permit claiming all 3561 files of #91/#92 were enumerated by that endpoint.

result: No equivalent duplicate found in the three posted items or bmv candidate.

items.decision: Triggs positive curvature: #88/#94 introduced the same missing R[M] factor. #382 changes FastTriggs gradient context; #468 only handles absent/zero second derivatives. Neither fixes residual scaling. All 21 original fork corrector files retain the missing factor.

Similarity scale range: conversion history #57/#77 introduces determinant-then-cube-root; #304 extracts the rotation block before its determinant, without logarithmic scale recovery. All original fork convert.py files match the unfixed formula. Both Sim3 and RxSO3 are one shared-root improvement.

PF prior covariance: #182/#218 introduce n*P; #352 corrects batching axes but retains n*P. Earlier unmerged #170 uses a different PF/Kalman-like proposal sampled from process covariance Q, not a correction from n*P to the public prior covariance P. All original fork PF files retain n*P.

bmv out buffer: #218 introduced direct vector out forwarding to a matrix result. Open #369 clones input operands and removes an in-place squeeze but still passes the unexpanded out to matmul, so it still resizes a strided output. All 21 original fork linalg files retain the same out behavior.

discarded_candidate.reason: Existing open #369 already changes the in-place clock update; candidate discarded before posting.
